-- A name is safe only if it is a plain file name: non-empty,
-- no path separators, and not a relative step such as "..".
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex safe_name("notes.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("../secret.txt") == False
  ex safe_name("sub/a.txt") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  if name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\"
      return False
  True

-- Returns the text of notes/name. Any unsafe, missing, or unreadable
-- name yields "". No name can reach a file outside notes.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre name.char_count() >= 0
  post safe_name(name) or out == ""
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
  if safe_name(name) == False
    return ""
  var text = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    text = fs.read(name) else ""
  text
